name: DuckDuckGo, optional Duck.ai
summary: The DuckDuckGo APK is the Android installer for the DuckDuckGo private browser, with tracker blocking, private search, the one-tap Fire Button and optional Duck.ai chat. The latest version is 5.304.0, updated November 24, 2026, and it needs Android 9 or newer. It's free, with an optional paid subscription.
metaDescription: DuckDuckGo APK download for Android: get DuckDuckGo 5.304.0 from Google Play, with tracker blocking, the Fire Button, Duck.ai and install steps.

faq.q: How do I install DuckDuckGo on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for DuckDuckGo and check the developer is DuckDuckGo before tapping Install. It needs Android 9 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from DuckDuckGo and may be altered, so the safest way to use DuckDuckGo is the official listing.
DuckDuckGo doesn't build a profile of your searches and blocks many trackers in its browser. Google offers more personalised results. For privacy, DuckDuckGo collects far less about you.
Duck.ai is DuckDuckGo's optional AI chat, which lets you use AI models anonymously. It's optional and can be hidden in settings.
Yes. The browser and search are free. An optional subscription adds a VPN and identity-protection services in some countries.
